newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain ICO to issue 10 bln pta 6-year domestic bond.
newsitem.headline: Spain ICO to issue 10 bln pta 6-year domestic bond.

text.p: Spain's Official Credit Institute (ICO) will issue a six-year domestic bond for 10 billion pesetas, according to the prospectus presented on Wednesday to the stock market commission CNMV.
ICO said the issue could be a maximum of 15 billion pesetas. The bond will have 6.11 percent coupon for the first three years, and will then pay 13.75 percent minus the 12-month MIBOR.

ICO could pay back the bond at par, at the end of the third, fourth and five year. The minimun tranche is 25 million pesetas, the issue date is February 27, and Natwest Markets has been designated lead manager.
